query:
SELECT 
  m.attendeeId,
  COUNT(*) as total_meetings,
  GROUP_CONCAT(m.timeSlot ORDER BY m.timeSlot) as slots,
  GROUP_CONCAT(s.companyName ORDER BY m.timeSlot SEPARATOR ' | ') as sponsors
FROM meetings m
JOIN sponsors s ON s.id = m.sponsorId
WHERE m.isVisible = 1
GROUP BY m.attendeeId
HAVING COUNT(*) > 8
ORDER BY total_meetings DESC;
